subject: Request: provisioning custody packet (SCIM / SAML assertions & RBAC snapshot) - ClearLake
messages:
From: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@clearlake-labs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: provisioning custody packet (SCIM / SAML assertions & RBAC snapshot)

Hi Logan,

We're kicking off our SIG/SOC2 intake for ClearLake's integration with Redwood and the security team asked us to collect a full "provisioning custody" packet to validate identity & access controls. Can you help produce the following artifacts for tenant id CL-4721 (prod):

- SCIM delta export covering the last 90 days (CSV preferred)
- A few SAML assertion samples (raw XML) for two recent auth events
- RBAC snapshot (role -> user mapping) and a brief note on how service accounts are scoped
- Redaction guidance / examples for any PII or email fields we shouldn't store in the packet

We're on a fairly tight timeline — can we get this by EOD next Tuesday (2028-09-19)? If not, please propose an ETA. Also, note that our security reviewer will need a short (1-paragraph) attestation that the artifacts are representative and that keys/credentials are excluded.

If there are constraints (e.g., samples that can't be exported exactly), call them out and we can accept masked or redacted variants.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Reyes
InfoSec Lead — ClearLake Labs
sofia.reyes@clearlake-labs.com

(Attachment request: example CSV schema they expect; actual attachments to follow in secure upload)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@clearlake-labs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 16:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisioning custody packet (SCIM / SAML assertions & RBAC snapshot)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and the clear checklist. We can produce the requested artifacts; below is the proposed delivery plan and a few clarifying points.

Planned deliverables (zipped package):
- scim-delta-20280831.csv (SCIM user & group delta for tenant CL-4721; includes add/modify/remove events)
- saml-assertion-samples-20280831.txt (3 raw assertion samples, timestamps redacted to preserve user privacy)
- rbac-snapshot-20280830.json (role-to-principal mapping; service accounts flagged)
- redaction-guidance.txt (fields removed/masked and rationale)
- attestation.txt (one-paragraph statement about representativeness and exclusion of secrets)

Timeline:
- Initial export & assembly: by EOD Monday (2028-09-18)
- Internal redaction review: morning Tuesday (2028-09-19)
- Secure upload and confirmation: by 1600 PDT Tuesday (2028-09-19)

Notes / constraints:
- We cannot include private keys or full audit logs in the package; we will provide assertion samples and event deltas instead.
- Service account identifiers will be included but any long-lived credentials are excluded.
- If you require time-of-auth timestamps in full, we can provide them under a separate NDA; otherwise we will supply offset/redacted timestamps.

Marcus will pull the RBAC snapshot and supervise data redaction; Priyom will confirm that the exported artifacts match our SOC2 control boundaries. Marcus / Priyom — can you confirm ETA and any known blockers?

Sofia — does your team have a preferred SFTP endpoint or should we use our secure Drive upload link (shared below)?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Security & Compliance Operations — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com

Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/CL-4721/scim-deliverables

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@clearlake-labs.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Sep 2028 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisioning custody packet (SCIM / SAML assertions & RBAC snapshot)

On Fri, Sep 14, 2028 at 4:14 PM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and the clear checklist. We can produce the requested artifacts; below is the proposed delivery plan and a few clarifying points.

Thanks Logan — quick confirmation from my side: I will extract the SCIM delta and RBAC snapshot this morning. A couple of specifics from engineering:

- SCIM delta will include attributes: user.id, user.userName, emails[*].value (masked where required), groups, meta.lastModified, and changeType. We will provide a small sample (first 10 rows) inline in the package for quick review; full CSV will be in the zip.
- RBAC snapshot will be a role mapping export; we will include a short CSV summary mapping role -> count of principals and a JSON detail file (rbac-snapshot-20280830.json).
- SAML assertions: engineering can export the raw XML but will scrub NameID and IP addresses; we will mark fields that were redacted.

Blockers / constraints:
- We do not store plaintext passwords or private keys — so nothing of that sort will be in the package.
- For multi-tenant tenants with shadow accounts, we will include owner-of-record and service-account annotations. If ClearLake needs a deeper trace, we will need a targeted signed request (we can discuss).

ETA: exports ready by EOD Monday (2028-09-18). Priyom, I'll hand the package to you for redaction review Tuesday morning.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering — Access & Provisioning — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments (placeholders): scim-delta-20280831.csv (export), rbac-snapshot-20280830.json (export), saml-assertion-samples-20280831.txt (export)

From: Sofia Reyes <sofia.reyes@clearlake-labs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlake-labs.com
Date: Sat, 15 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisioning custody packet (SCIM / SAML assertions & RBAC snapshot)

Hi Logan / Marcus — appreciate the quick confirmation and helpful notes. EOD Tuesday (9/19) works for us; please upload to the Drive link you mentioned and reply-all when it's complete.

A couple of small asks from our side before you publish:
- Can you include a short README.txt that lists which fields were redacted and why?
- Please include the tenant id in the filename (CL-4721) as that makes ingestion on our side much faster.

We've logged a ticket on our side (SEC-1023) and the reviewer will look at the artifacts as soon as they're available: https://clearlake.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1023

If anything changes on timing, please call my cell: +1 (415) 555-0183. Thanks again — looking forward to the package.

Best,
Sofia
